label: À La Carte
title: Dining Room
description: Urban Hearth is designed for those who love to dine well. The room is intimate, lively, and comfortable, with a quiet sense of luxury that invites guests to linger over another glass of wine, another course, another conversation. Warm and gracious hospitality creates an experience that feels refined and easy whether you are celebrating a milestone or the end of a busy day.

The à la carte menu, available in the dining room, bar, and salon, follows the seasons. Rooted in locally sourced ingredients and informed by culinary traditions from around the world, the menu changes as ingredients come into season and new ideas emerge.

We approach our beverage program with the same care and curiosity that guide our kitchen. The wine list features both celebrated producers and emerging voices, with an emphasis on character, place, and balance. Seasonal cocktails showcase exceptional spirits and house-made ingredients, alongside a broad selection of beer, cider, and non-alcoholic beverages.

label: Chef's Tasting Menu
title: Chef's Counter
description: An intimate front-row seat to the creative heart of Urban Hearth.

Join us at our six-seat Chef’s Counter for a tasting menu of 8–12 courses inspired by the season, the farm, and the larder. Watch the kitchen at work, hear about each dish from the chefs who made it, and experience every course as it’s finished and presented.
Led by Chef Erin Miller, a 2025 James Beard Award nominee for Best Chef: Northeast, the menu showcases exceptional local ingredients, foraged discoveries, and refined technique.
The Chef’s Counter experience is available Tuesday through Saturday at 5:45 and 8:15 pm.

We offer an omnivore or vegetarian menu. Please note which you’d prefer in your reservation. We can also accommodate the following dietary restrictions: Pescatarian, Mammal-free, Nut-free, Shellfish-free, Gluten-free, Dairy-free. If you have a combination of these or any other dietary restrictions, please email concierge@urbanhearth.net before booking. Please note your dietary restrictions and any other special requests in your reservation.

label: Bar & Salon
title: Bar & Salon
description: The Salon & 12-seat Bar celebrates Urban Hearth's more spontaneous side. With its own easy rhythm and lively energy, it's the kind of place that invites you to settle in and stay awhile.

Gather over thoughtful wines, craft cocktails, and seasonally inspired shared plates, whether you're stopping by for a glass before dinner, meeting friends for the evening, or lingering over a few bites and one more bottle. The room hums with conversation and connection, balancing warmth and energy with the simple pleasure of being genuinely well cared for.
Walk-ins are always welcome; reservations are recommended for groups of four or more.
The Salon is also available for private gatherings, celebrations, and special events. To inquire about hosting your event, please contact our events team at events@urbanhearth.net.
